name: Password Change
summary: Executes authenticated self-service password replacement through the stable authentication flow boundary and emits canonical success or failure outcomes.
notes: The generated client and REST route remain stable; this flow is the application-level entry point behind that transport contract.
Both canonical outcomes share the same executable flow and diverge only after the credential operation returns its result.

sourceReferences.note: AuthenticationFlowService.ChangePasswordAsync is the stable application front door.
Handler dispatches to the password manager and emits the canonical outcome transition.
